title: mentha viridis var. lejeuneana
intro: Mentha viridis var. lejeuneana, commonly known as West Indian mint, is a subspecies of the spearmint plant, characterized by its distinctive flavor and aroma. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing nausea and digestive issues, as well as providing relief from headaches and fever. The therapeutic actions of West Indian mint include its ability to act as an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it useful in treating respiratory issues and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of West Indian mint include menthol, menthone, and limonene, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and aroma.
